items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: me and Procope, we got in a cab... featuring... Russell Procope... [INTERVIEWEE] Uh huh.

ctx.x: That was when we were in Canada. Some woman called and said that [Willie] (Jimmy) Cook was in there on the floor, and she was scared, because I think he knocked himself out, you know? With one of those shots. You see, so she asked if one of us could come and get him and do something about him, because she was by herself and she couldn't do nothing.

So me and Procope, we got in a cab and we went down to this house, where he was out there, and we hit him; you know, we gave him some coffee and we just did everything to wake him up, you know? But he had shot himself over, you know, because he did that many times; he used to do it all the time because a lot of things, in theatres, he used to go in the men's room and one time I saw blood in the seat of the toilet, and that's where he used to do it. He shot himself.
